title: Variable Pulse Delay
text: Delay samples by controlled, continuously variable amount, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Initial Input} sets the value at the output port before and {Buffer Size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: in
ports.summary: Input sample data fixed step discrete sample | variable step discrete sample

ports.name: delay
ports.summary: Introduces delay to input signal nonnegative scalar

ports.name: out
ports.summary: Delayed output sample fixed step discrete sample | variable step discrete sample

params.name: Initial Input
params.values: The value at the output port before simulation 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Buffer Size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 1 (default) | positive scalar integer
